caption: The video captures a sunset sky over a calm body of water, where deep purple-blue cloud cover hangs above a bright band of yellow-orange light along a thin, dark ridge of land, the glow reflecting off the surface below. A scattered flock of tiny birds occupies the upper-right sky, drifting slowly toward the top-right corner. Partway through, several larger silhouettes appear low in the scene already in flight, sweeping rightward just above the waterline. One bird tracks steadily across the lower sky while others rise and pass beyond the right edge, none showing a takeoff or landing. The land silhouette and cloud pattern hold their positions, consistent with a stationary camera as the birds provide the visible motion. The nearer birds continue their rightward glide to the end, still traveling.
